provenance.reference_only_contract: Exact target counts; global off-target noise is unavailable for Bloom runs

definitions.complete_gt1: All physical reference k-mer windows have saturated pooled count >1; no ratio or ambiguity constraint
definitions.kd: Distinct canonical k-mers within the named block, missing from the pooled reads at the named count cutoff
definitions.coverage: Pooled canonical k-mer occurrence count, not assigned per-strand read depth
definitions.feasible: Exact unmodified reference path satisfies the adapter directed integer-rounded coverage rule
definitions.overflow: Original 1050-live-path search limit; the index search discards its full candidate pool on overflow
definitions.union_loss: Classifies absence of an unmodified exact path among failed RS-recovery indices; it does not enumerate every correctable one-symbol neighbour
definitions.links: Counted by DBGPS-links, sum(count-1) for keys shared by distinct reference strands; count cap1023
definitions.noise: Global full-read-index noise only for processed k19; Bloom runs do not estimate off-reference noise
